title: perf(canary): automated regression detector and rollout guard for latency/throughput
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Motivation: Reduce production regressions by adding an automated canary detector that flags latency and throughput degradations and prevents unsafe rollouts. This PR introduces a detector that continuously evaluates per-route latency P95 and throughput against baseline windows, applies hysteresis, and surfaces anomalies to the rollout policy engine. It also adds a rollout guard that blocks canary promotion when the detector reports sustained regressions or when CI perf-tests fail. Scope: detector, policy engine, config schema, unit+e2e perf tests, docs and example configs. Checklist: - [x] Detector state machine and scoring logic; - [x] Integration with existing perf-canary service; - [x] Configurable thresholds/hysteresis via canary/config.yaml; - [x] Rollout guard that hooks into rollout service (canary manager); - [x] End-to-end perf tests (synthetic load + regression injection); - [x] CI workflow and alerting integration; - [x] Docs and migration notes. Backwards compatibility: guard is opt-in by default; existing canaries without the new config continue to behave as before. Related: ENG-3245 (canary observability), SRE-112 (incident followup for #INC-2026).

review_comments: Carlos Mendes (review): Overall approach looks good — please clarify how we compute the baseline window for routes with sparse traffic.

Aisha Kapoor (reply): Baseline uses hybrid windowing: 7d rolling when traffic >= threshold, fallback to synthetic baseline for sparse routes. Added explanation in docs and in detector config comments.
Leah Chen (request changes): Can we add hysteresis to avoid flip-flopping on short spikes? Also add an integration test for a transient spike.

Aisha Kapoor (reply): Added hysteresis parameters (rise/fall counts + decay) and a transient spike e2e test that asserts no guard trip for single short spike. Test added in tests/perf/test_canary_detection.py::test_transient_spike_no_trip.
Jared Mills (comment): CI perf job flaked once on first run; reran and it passed. Consider adding a retry wrapper in the CI step.
Leah Chen (approval): Approved after requested changes were addressed.
SRE oncall (comment): Will enable guard in staging for 48h and monitor alerts; thanks for making the feature opt-in by default.
release_notes: Added automated canary regression detector which evaluates latency (P95) and throughput against baselines.
Added rollout guard that can block canary promotions when sustained regressions are detected.
Configurable thresholds and hysteresis parameters; opt-in by default.
Perf canary CI workflow and example configs added.
